justification: GST-4019 deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run (CREW rule 15). No pinned file changes: ship/sections, review/ checklists, lib/review-depth.ts and lib/review-risk.ts keep their bytes, so every brief body cut from the sections and every depth rule is unchanged. The new text reaches only slice readers, which exist only when one reader's kept diff is over the 2,000,000-byte ceiling, where main stopped with REVIEW_DIFF_TOO_LARGE and no reader ran. Under the ceiling, a replay at main be64b10 and at this branch's final head ran gstack-review-dispatch pass (--depth-floor full) and stage voices on three fixtures (plain code, review_exclude_paths with kept and excerpted files, 20 deleted files): all 12 rendered briefs and payloads, the pass manifests (state_at removed) and the ledgers (at removed) are byte-identical (12 briefs, 27 artifacts compared, 0 differ). Over the ceiling, test/review-slices.test.ts runs every git diff command each slice brief carries against git and checks that the slices share no file and together cover every file the unsliced reader would have read (5 MB across 3 folders, review_exclude_paths with kept files, 92 deleted files, bracket, quote, tab, backslash and non-ASCII paths), so no file a reviewer would have seen is lost; a native slice's fixture summary command lists only that slice's test, fixture and spec files under the same exclusions.
